contracts.name: FundFactory
contracts.notes: Phase 1a raise/mint only. FundVault and FundNFT are created per fund by createFund. Deploy tx 0x3b02110bb45f421591c6712ce4498b5533286cbaf4d46581a1ed0c6deea49bf3. Owner and feeRecipient 0x9a21c75aC263cC43125E70200636f6397f8776d0. Sourcify is the verification of record. This factory is not the Phase 2 factory.

contracts.name: FundSwapFacet
contracts.notes: Phase 2 swap body. Vaults delegatecall it. Deployed by 0x9a21c75aC263cC43125E70200636f6397f8776d0 at nonce 34. Creation bytecode matches that commit (solc 0.8.24, via-IR, optimizer 200, Paris). Security scan, not a review: docs/security/phase2-live-scan.md.

contracts.name: UniswapV3RouterAdapter
contracts.notes: Adapts SwapRouter02 0xCaf681a66D020601342297493863E78C959E5cb2 to IFundSwapRouter.swap. Nonce 35. WETH 0x0Bd7D308f8E1639FAb988df18A8011f41EAcAD73. This adapter is the allowlisted router. Raw SwapRouter02 is not allowlisted.

contracts.name: FundAllowlist
contracts.notes: Nonce 36. Owner 0x9a21c75aC263cC43125E70200636f6397f8776d0. Delay 172800 seconds. Quote WETH. One router, the adapter. No non-quote asset and no feed. Later edits wait the delay. The delay cannot be shortened.

contracts.name: FundFactoryInvest
contracts.notes: Nonce 37. Owner and feeRecipient 0x9a21c75aC263cC43125E70200636f6397f8776d0. Protocol fee 20 bps. Fund count 0 at scan. vaultDeployer 0x111aC00A91944477141aDe12ebB6BcB0CEFC3a95. nftDeployer 0x5766A7A937D0De897C2d90df0D045f9067fd72D5. Does not replace the Phase 1a factory.
